PhD programmes
Click here for information on application and admission
PhD in Mathematical Sciences
Advance the frontiers of mathematical discovery through original research at NTU. The PhD in Mathematical Sciences offers rigorous training in advanced research areas, close mentorship from expert faculty and access to state-of-the-art computational resources, preparing graduates for impactful careers in academia, industry and beyond.
PhD in Physics
Push the boundaries of scientific discovery through cutting-edge research in physics and applied physics. NTU’s PhD in Physics offers advanced research training, close mentorship from leading faculty and opportunities to explore fundamental and applied challenges, preparing graduates for impactful careers in academia, research and high-technology industries.
PhD in Chemistry
Advance the frontiers of chemical science through rigorous research and discovery. NTU’s PhD in Chemistry combines advanced coursework with hands-on research under expert faculty supervision, equipping candidates with deep scientific expertise and the skills to tackle complex challenges in academia, industry and innovation-driven sectors.
PhD in Biological Sciences
Drive discoveries that advance our understanding of life and health. NTU’s PhD in Biological Sciences combines rigorous research training, advanced coursework and hands-on laboratory experience under expert faculty mentorship, preparing graduates to become leading scientists in academia, biomedical research and the biotechnology industry.
PhD in Earth and Environmental Science
Address some of the world’s most pressing environmental challenges through impactful interdisciplinary research. NTU’s PhD in Earth and Environmental Science combines rigorous training across environmental science, ecology, technology and human-environment interactions with close faculty mentorship, preparing graduates to become leaders in academia, research, policy and industry.
MSc by coursework programmes
Click here for information on application and admission
MSc in Precision Scientific Instrumentation
Master the technologies that power modern science and advanced manufacturing. This Master of Science programme combines training in scientific instrumentation, solid-state physics, microelectronics, optoelectronics and materials science, equipping graduates with the expertise to drive innovation across high-tech industries and research environments.
MSc in Analytics
Turn data into strategic insights and business impact. This Master of Science programme combines applied mathematics, data science and analytical methods to solve complex challenges across business, finance and industry, equipping graduates with sought-after skills for data-driven decision-making in the modern economy.
MSc in Financial Technology
Shape the future of finance with cutting-edge digital technologies. This Master of Science programme combines data science, artificial intelligence and information technology with applications in financial automation, blockchain and digital financial services, equipping graduates to drive innovation in the rapidly evolving FinTech sector.
MSc in Modelling and Simulation
Build your vision of the future through advanced computational modelling and simulation. This Master of Science programme combines training in modelling, artificial intelligence and specialised applications, equipping graduates to solve complex challenges across industries such as healthcare, aerospace, finance, technology and scientific research.
MSc in Environmental Sustainability Science
Develop the knowledge and skills to address today’s most pressing sustainability challenges. This Master of Science programme combines sustainability science, systems thinking and science communication with real-world case studies and industry collaboration, preparing graduates to drive meaningful impact in research, policy, consultancy and environmental practice.
MSc in BioBusiness and BioEntrepreneurship
Bridge scientific innovation and business impact in the rapidly evolving life sciences sector. NTU’s Master of Science in BioBusiness and BioEntrepreneurship combines expertise in biomedicine, biotechnology and business management, equipping graduates to transform breakthrough discoveries into successful ventures across healthcare, biotechnology and related industries.
MSc in Biomedical Data Science
Harness the power of data to advance healthcare and biomedical innovation. This Master of Science programme combines data science, artificial intelligence and life sciences through hands-on learning, with specialisations in Bioinformatics, Biotechnology or Artificial Intelligence to prepare graduates for impactful careers in biomedical research and industry.
MSc in Chinese Medicine
Deepen your expertise in traditional and integrative healthcare through Singapore’s first locally conferred postgraduate Chinese Medicine programme, which combines advanced clinical training, research capabilities and evidence-based practice, preparing graduates to excel in modern healthcare and Chinese Medicine practice.
MSc in Chemical Sciences and Instrumentation
Advance your expertise in modern chemistry through hands-on training and cutting-edge technologies. This Master of Science programme equips graduates with practical skills in advanced instrumentation, artificial intelligence and nanotechnology, preparing them for impactful careers in research, development and the chemical industry.
MSc by research programmes
Click here for information on application and admission
MSc (Research) in Mathematical Sciences
Develop advanced expertise in mathematics through NTU’s MSc in Mathematical Sciences, a research-focused programme that combines rigorous coursework with original research. Guided by leading faculty, you will deepen your analytical and problem-solving skills while completing a research thesis in an intellectually stimulating environment.
MSc (Research) in Physics
Advance your understanding of the physical world through NTU’s MSc in Physics, a research-based programme that combines advanced coursework with original research in physics and applied physics. Guided by leading academics, you will develop strong analytical, experimental, and problem-solving skills for careers in research and technology.
MSc (Research) in Chemistry
Advance your expertise in chemistry through NTU’s MSc in Chemistry, a research-focused programme that combines advanced coursework with original research. Working alongside leading scientists, you will develop deep scientific knowledge and hands-on research skills in a globally recognised chemistry environment.
MSc (Research) in Biological Sciences
Advance your scientific expertise through impactful research in the life sciences. NTU’s Master of Science (Research) in Biological Sciences combines original research with advanced coursework, hands-on laboratory training and close faculty mentorship, preparing graduates for careers in research, biotechnology, healthcare and further doctoral studies.
MSc (Research) in Earth and Environmental Science
Pursue cutting-edge research in Earth and Environmental Science with NTU’s Master by Research programme. Working closely with expert faculty, you will explore real-world environmental challenges, undertake an independent research project, and build advanced analytical and communication skills in a flexible, interdisciplinary learning environment.
NTU Graduate Admissions, Programmes and Courses
Explore NTU’s Lifelong Learning programmes, including Continuing Education & Training, Graduate Programmes (by Coursework), and Graduate Programmes (by Research).
Find out more about NTU graduate admissions, programmes and courses
NTU Graduate Scholarships
The university offers a wide variety of scholarships and funding options for incoming graduate students.
Find out more about NTU's graduate scholarships
Research Areas in CoS
CoS offers innovative and inter-disciplinary programmes in a diversity of scientific disciplines within a vibrant and stimulating community where knowledge is constantly created, imparted and exchanged.
View our research areas
Joint PhD Programmes
NTU, and CoS, offers a number of Joint PhD programmes with partner universities overseas.
Find out more about our Joint PhD programmes
CoS Transferable Skills Programme
The CoS Transferable Skills Programme aims to impart skills to our students that are relevant to both research and careers beyond their time at NTU.
Find out more about the CoS Transferable Skills Programme
